scalars.scalar_value: Any combination of education and experience equivalent to High School Diploma or GED or any equivalent combination of education, training or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and ability.
A minimum of 1 year of paid employment experience doing custodial or building maintenance assignments is required. Experience at an academic institution is preferred.

items.item_text: A valid driver’s license is required or equivalent means of reliable transportation to off-site meetings and events.

Any combination of education and experience equivalent to High School Diploma or GED or any equivalent combination of education, training or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and ability.
A minimum of 1 year of paid employment experience doing custodial or building maintenance assignments is required. Experience at an academic institution is preferred.
Perform periodic and annual cleaning services/duties for executive suites and offices.
Clean toilets, urinals, windows, light fixtures, and furnishings.
Dust and polish a variety of surfaces and wash walls.
Clean and disinfect a variety of surfaces.
Clean writing surfaces and erasers in classrooms.
Scrub and refinish floors and/or carpets. Refinish hard, resilient and wood floors with mechanical floor cleaners, polishers, and carpet cleaning equipment.
Dispose of trash and other debris.
Order supplies and track inventory for the campus on items required (chemical, paper, specialized equipment).
Maintain campus laundry by ensuring pick up of wash rags, wedge mops, dust mops, finish mops.
Deliver supplies to buildings and student dorms. Ensure each building is fully stocked (toilet paper, paper towels).
Collect scrubbing pads for proper sanitation.
Deliver and maintain a log for usage of Floor and Extractor machine.
